turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?

I have pain in my mouth and forehead, with pain in my right cheek and nose. I also have a cold in the last 2 weeks, a cough, fever, greenish or yellowish nasal discharge, and I’ve lost my sense of smell.
[ASK] Do you have new/worsening shortness of breath (or difficulty breathing) at rest?
[ASK] Do you have sudden onset of severe shortness of breath (often within hours) with frothy sputum or known heart failure?
[ASK] Do you have a fever (≥38°C) with new cough and body aches that started within the last 7 days?
I have a fever, and I have a cough. I don’t know about body aches or whether it started within the last 7 days.
[ASK] Do you have a high fever (≥ 38°C) with chills/body aches?
